Results.ReviewText: The top half of the kettle, does not fit very good.                 If you move the grill it will fall off. My 33 year old weber is a much better fit, the top half stays put.... Quality is not there on the new one..
Results.Title: Quality is not there on the new grill..

Results.ReviewText: Using it a few times a week.  The copper color is amazing !Love it!
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: I have had gas grills for 25 years. I feel like I have been missing out for the last 25 years. I have purchased my first charcoal grill and it’s a Weber, I don’t know why I didn’t switch over to charcoal years ago. The flavors are amazing and Weber has figured out how to make using charcoal simple.
Results.Title: Go charcoal

Results.ReviewText: There are much better charcoal grills out there for less money. Lacking grate height adjustment. Too deep. Unhinged lid. Bad airflow design. Overrated.
Results.Title: Overhyped overpriced

Results.ReviewText: Always enjoy real charcoal flavor and webers last almost forever
Results.Title: High quality

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Original Kettle truly is the gold standard of grills. You can cook low and slow, hot and fast, and even smoke on it. It's a joy to cook on for those who like cooking. You can keep the grills with apps and augers. Manning the grill is half the enjoyment.
Results.Title: Gold Standard of Grills

Results.ReviewText: The last charcoal Weber Grill we had lasted 16 plus years . Finally had to get a new one and we love it just as much !
Results.Title: Weber withstands the Test of Time

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber! The new green color is so fun! Best charcoal grill on the market in my opinion.
Results.Title: New green grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my first grill so I have a learning curve. It has done a great job with brats and burgers so far. Will try a steak when I can.
Results.Title: My first grill it is great.

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: Depuis que j’ai acheté mon weber au charbon kettle premium, je n’utilise que lui pour mes bbq. Le plus bel achat que j’ai fait!!
Results.Title: Meilleur achat!!!!

Results.ReviewText: It’s what you expect from Weber—a quality grill which is easy to use.
Results.Title: Twenty-two charcoal grill.

Results.ReviewText: The hook inside the lid is no longer a feature, this was the best part of the design. Now I have to set the lid on the ground or hold it whenever doing anything on the grill. Super upset by this.
Results.Title: They ruined the one of the best parts!

Results.ReviewText: NOTHING beats the original of anything! This certainly applies to Weber. The improvements made over the years have been minimal due to the fact that it is hard to improve GREATNESS. Thank you!
Results.Title: Can't Beat the Original!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We will be sure to share this with our team. We are so sorry to hear about your lid being warped. We are happy help with a new lid. Our Support team is reaching out to follow up. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Photos.Caption: Better if handle was vertical as you need great arm strength to hang on grill side. Hard to do on a hot grill

Results.ReviewText: As a grill it is great, but took off a stars for the design of the cover. To use the latch to hang the cover on the grill, one has to turn their hand horizontal to the ground (palm up) and secure. It would be much more natural and require less strength to be able to hold the cover handle in a vertical position with your thumb grip facing up. I thought it might have been built incorrectly by the store but there is no other orientation to put on the handle. Also my cover seems a bit warped so the cover does not sit properly without much repositioning. I was told all Weber grills are assembled for customer, but I believe it was a floor model as it had a price tag stuck on lid. No way that occurs out of box, thus being a floor model I think that explains the warping. If I had not used it I would consider returning. Main recommendation - fix cover design.
Results.Title: Great grill, poor cover design

Results.ReviewText: This was on my “wish list”: a 22” Copper Kettle. And it’s upgraded from my original 22” with the Ash Catcher. Love the added feature.
Results.Title: Copper Is King

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Many years ago we had this grill and it was a pain having to start the charcoal and wait for it to get hot or more often than not, the coals would not light and we struggled to get a flame going. We decided that a gas grill was the way to go, but nothing has the same flavor as food cooked on charcoal. Since our children introduced us to the charcoal chimney which works fast everytime-we will never go back!!! P.S. I would really love to win a 70th anniversary grill please:)
Results.Title: Back to Better Barbeque!!

Results.ReviewText: I'v only every owed hand-me-down grills, rescued from neighbors. All of these have been Weber, and all have done great work, but this is my first new grill I've owned...This Grill is beautiful (copper), I'm enjoying getting to know it. I love the ease of ash removal, and control of temperature. I feel I can actually cook on this grill as opposed to the semi controlled burns of the past. The learning curve is greater than I expected, and I'm still getting the hang of it. After having zero control for the past 25 or so years, I find this grill closer to the amount of control I have in the kitchen. I love it!
Results.Title: I Love My New Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the larger grill but there seems to be a slight balance problem when moving it.  If you lift the non-wheeled side just a bit too high when moving it, it will tip over.  Why not put a locking wheel on that leg so it can be wheeled around without lifting when done but locked in place when cooking? the grill itself is great!
Results.Title: Love but…

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback regarding the damper handle. We will be sure to share this with our team. We would recommend using a grill mitt as all parts of the grill can get hot with use. Our Support team will be reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Grill is ok. Wish the damper on the lid had the same burn protection piece that the next step up has. Asked if I could buy that separately and was told “no!”  Not happy about that. Seems a simple safety piece like that should be a given on all grills and not a premium piece.
Results.Title: Just ok.

Results.ReviewText: This kettle has received several upgrades since I purchased my previous one!  The lower vent holes were reshaped and are better for removing spent ash.  Also better for keeping charcoal lit!
Results.Title: Updated design.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill and the way I am able to deliver perfectly cooked meals.  Highly recommend.
Results.Title: Highly recommend

Results.ReviewText: I’ve always wanted this grill; it met my expectations for sure. The grill having the foldable grill made it perfect for adjusting the coals. It’s a great design, and perfect.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: This is the third Weber Charcoal Grill I have owned.  This spans over 40 years and looking back I would say that the first grill I purchased was the best charcoal grill that was available then and the same is true today.  One slight change they have made that I don't like.  Not sure when this happened but, I suspect it was when they added a thermometer to the lid, the hook that is mounted under the lid to secure the lid to the grill while cooking with the lid off, at one time was mounted parallel to the handle.  This was a comfortable position to use by the person grilling.  Now, the hook is mounted perpendicular to the handle, which creates a much more difficult angle on the wrist and could easily lead to a burn on the arm because of the contortions required to hang the lid.
Results.Title: Love it, BUT.

Results.ReviewText: Easy assembly, good quality...dumped the gas grille and cooking over coals again!  Venting controls work for temperature control and the ash-dump is a nice feature.
Results.Title: Nice grille!

Results.ReviewText: Cooks very well. It looks nice when in use and when you put it away. You can adjust the ventilation as needed and it does not take up a lot of space and is easy to use. The lid hooks on which is great and as our first grill it is fantastic. I would 100% recommend. My only recommendation would be if you could adjust the height of the grill to make it taller if needed. Aside from that it’s perfect for what we need.
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love it, usually I use my Weber propane grill, this cooks Chicken and Filet's nice and juicy. Just wish the legs were a little more sturdy.
Results.Title: Propane backup!

Results.ReviewText: This is my 4th Weber grill and it is highly recommended to friends and family.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. It is the perfect size and the copper color compliments our patio. Easy to clean and keep in perfect condition
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: I should’ve got one of these along time ago. My food game has been taken to another level with this grill. Absolutely fantastic.
Results.Title: Amazing- Buy one now!

Results.ReviewText: This is a great product. Please buy the Weber chimney and the lighter cubes at time of purchase. You will not be disappointed.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium and Accessories

Results.ReviewText: Excellent finish. Just like the one I had 20 years ago!
Results.Title: I like a Weber

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size, easy to use and clean. I love the versatility.
Results.Title: Nice fit for the deck

Results.ReviewText: Getting better with the quality of grill parts. Easy assembly.
Results.Title: None

Results.ReviewText: Just a great grill all around! Attached ash catcher makes cleaning a breeze! Temp gauge on the hood let’s me know when temp is ready to cook! Very pleased and highly recommended!
Results.Title: This grill has it all!

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
